evals.name: full-run-az-flooring
evals.prompt: Scrape flooring stores in Arizona for me. Core search terms are fine, 200 places per term. I already know roughly what it costs, you have my green light, go ahead and run the whole thing through to the final list.
evals.expected_output: Full pipeline runs: plan shows $6.00 cap for 5x200 places, scrape (fixture), clean, verify (mock); leads/clean has exactly one file, <date>_AZ_flooring_clean-13.csv, with only ok emails (no risky/removed CSVs); catch-all, unknown and invalid emails are dropped and counted in runs.csv; final summary with real counts.

evals.name: cost-gate-tx-fl-coating
evals.prompt: can you pull epoxy / garage floor coating contractors in texas and florida? both are big states so go deep
evals.expected_output: Plans two batches (TX, FL, coating segment), suggests a larger per-term cap for big states, shows a per-state Apify hard cap and MillionVerifier estimate plus a combined total, and asks for a yes. Does NOT start any scrape.

evals.name: repeat-state-dedupe
evals.prompt: Let's run Arizona flooring again, this time with the full search term list and 150 per term. Approved, go.
evals.expected_output: Notices AZ flooring was already done on 2026-09-20; cap is 10 terms x 150 x $0.006 = $9.00; runs full pipeline on fixture; every previously delivered business is removed as already in an earlier batch; zero new clean leads and says so clearly; runs.csv has 2 rows.
